remarks: Waterfront Village Townhome with 1,700 sq ft of living space on three levels, in the established Breakwaters Community. Two private balconies, two-car attached garage, and an association fee covering water, sewer, trash, snow removal, landscaping, exterior window cleaning, seasonal bug spraying, structural maintenance and insurance — genuine low-maintenance living a short walk from Lake Erie. Pet friendly--association allows one dog under 50 lbs and/or one cat. Enter through the bright sun porch, fitted with brand-new windows in 2026. Hardwood flooring runs through the main living areas and a fireplace anchors the living room. The kitchen has been updated with newer appliances (2025) and refaced cabinetry with new hardware. The primary suite has a cathedral ceiling, walk-in cedar closet and sliding glass doors onto a composite balcony. An adjoining sitting area opens onto the same balcony. The second bedroom has its own full bath with a soaker tub. Newer windows throughout feature between-the-glass blinds. The finished lower level has the flexibility most townhomes at this price point lack--vinyl plank flooring, custom built-ins, a full bath, two closets and a separate storage room, with direct access from both the attached garage and the first floor. It serves equally well as a guest suite, family room or home office. Mechanically current: furnace and hot water tank both 2023, windows 2026. Minutes to Canalside, the Outer Harbor, Downtown and the new Ralph Wilson Centennial Park—a nine-figure public investment taking shape directly alongside this community. Experience Townhome living in one of Buffalo's most sought-after waterfront areas.
